items.title: Operating in the agentic era: AIOps sessions at re:Invent 2026
items.summary: Telemetry volume and incident counts keep growing while operations headcount stays flat, and coding tools now produce changes faster than most release processes can review them. The AIOps topic on the re:Invent 2026 Cloud Operations (COP) track covers how AI agents handle operational work: investigating incidents, recommending fixes, reviews code changes to catch issues before […]
items.creator: Matheus Arrais
